title: 排行榜
problem_statement_md:
给你一个程序，它应该输出排名为**偶数**的排行榜。
然而，有人在代码中添加和删除注释，破坏了这一逻辑。

请添加注释和取消注释来修复错误，让程序得到期望输出。
problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Leaderboard[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

You are given a program that should output the [b]even[/b] ranks of a leaderboard.
However, somebody added and removed comments in the code, breaking that logic.
Fix the code by commenting and uncommenting the corresponding lines to generate the desired output.
[note]The resulting program should output only the [b]even[/b] ranks of the leaderboard.[/note]
hint_md: 程序应该只输出排名为**偶数**的排行榜。
